faq: What do you check on each listing?
Title, price, images, description, variants, stock, shipping details, search fields, alt text and how the page looks on a phone. We score each item so you can see which ones hurt the page most.
Is this the same as a full SEO audit?
No. We check page-level search basics, like titles and descriptions, but not links, site speed or technical SEO. Those belong to a full SEO audit, which is a separate service.
Will you change my live listings without asking?
Quick, low-risk fixes such as missing alt text are done directly. Anything that changes a title, a price or a layout is shown to you first, so nothing surprises you.
Can you check marketplace listings like Amazon or Etsy?
This service works inside your own store. For marketplace listing reviews we have separate services, because each marketplace has its own rules for titles, images and categories.
desc:
A product listing quality check reviews your product pages the way a shopper sees them, finds what is missing or weak and fixes the quick items. Ecom Swift LLC scores each listing against a plain checklist and gives you a ranked list of what to improve first.

## What is a product listing quality check?

A listing quality check is a page-by-page review of how well your products are presented. We look at the title, price, images, description, variants, shipping details, search fields and mobile layout. Each listing receives a score against the same checklist, so you can see which pages are strong and which are letting down the store.

It is narrower than a full SEO audit. We focus on the product page itself and on the fields you control in the product editor, not on site-wide technical settings.

## Why weak listings go unnoticed

Owners rarely look at their own pages with fresh eyes. You know what the product is, so a vague title seems fine. You know the size, so a missing size chart seems minor. Meanwhile, a first-time visitor is hunting for those exact details.

Problems also hide on phones. A photo that looks sharp on a desktop monitor may be cropped badly on a small screen, and a long variant list may push the buy button out of view. A check on a real phone catches what a desktop view misses.

## How better listings change results

A listing sells when it removes doubt. A specific title tells the shopper what they are buying, a clear price and shipping note remove surprise, good images show the product from more than one angle and accurate options prevent wrong orders. Each fix addresses a reason a buyer might leave.

Search plays a part too. Titles, headings, alt text and meta descriptions help search engines match your page to what people type, and they influence whether the result gets clicked. What comes of any change depends on your market and your competitors, so we describe what we improve, not what you will earn.

## What we check on every listing

- Is the title specific and in a consistent pattern?
- Is the price clear, with compare-at prices used honestly?
- Are there enough sharp images, with the main image showing the full product?
- Does every image have useful alt text?
- Does the description answer the basic buying questions?
- Are variants complete, with correct stock and labeled sold-out options?
- Are shipping and returns details easy to find?
- Is there a search title and meta description?
- Does the page work well on a phone, including the buy button?
- Are there broken images, dead links or leftover draft text?

## How the review and fixes work

We open your listings, score each one and produce a ranked fix list, starting with the changes that matter most for the least effort. You see the full list before we touch anything live.

The Basic package reviews a short list of your best products and fixes a handful. Standard reviews more and fixes a larger group, improving weak titles and alt text, repairing image and variant problems and checking the mobile view. Premium reviews a broad set, adds a search title and meta check, prices a plan for the remaining work and includes a walkthrough call to go over the results. Bigger jobs, such as rewriting a hundred descriptions, are listed with a price so you can decide.

We only change live listings after you approve the list of fixes.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Start with your best sellers and most visited pages.
- Look at every listing on your own phone.
- Fix the cheap, quick problems before planning bigger rewrites.
- Re-check the pages after a month of changes.

**Avoid:**
- Judging listings only on a desktop screen.
- Rewriting titles for search at the cost of readability.
- Ignoring small gaps such as missing alt text.
- Treating the score as a ranking against other stores.

## Who this service is for

It suits an owner whose traffic is fine but whose orders feel low and who wants a clear list of weak spots. It suits a store that has recently added many products and wants a quality gate. It also suits a seller who plans to hire help for copy or photos and wants to know where to start.

## What we need from you

Send a list of the products or collections you care about most, or let us choose from your best sellers. Collaborator access to your store is all we need, with no password shared. Marketplace pages on other platforms may need their own access, so tell us in advance if you want those included.
